titleEn: How Much Does a Marble-Look Kitchen Renovation Cost in Richmond, BC? Real Project Tour 2026
titleZh: 大理石紋廚房裝修費用列治文：2026 年真實案例分析
contentEn:
A marble-look kitchen renovation in Richmond, BC costs between $70,000 and $120,000 depending on the scope and finish level in 2026. A whole-home renovation centred on a marble-look kitchen — like a recent Reno Stars project in Richmond — covers not just the kitchen but the powder room, staircase, and built-in storage, bringing the full project cost between $120,000 and $160,000. Here is what that looks like in practice.

What Makes a Marble-Look Kitchen Cost More in Richmond

The premium over a standard kitchen renovation comes from three decisions: the material chosen for the backsplash and counters, the cabinet door profile, and the hardware finish. Full-height marble-look porcelain slab costs $40–$120 per square foot installed versus $15–$40 for standard ceramic tile. Arched glass-front upper cabinets run $200–$500 more per linear foot than standard shaker doors. Brushed gold tapware and black undermount sinks add $800–$1,800 over basic chrome fixtures. Each choice compounds the total, but together they define a recognisable aesthetic that photographs well and holds value at resale.

Real Project: Whole Home Renovation with Marble-Look Kitchen in Richmond

This Reno Stars project in Richmond centred on a bright, detailed kitchen with a full-height marble-look slab covering both the backsplash and the counters, set against arched glass-front upper cabinets, brushed gold tapware, and a black undermount sink. The kitchen opened into a renovated staircase rebuilt in light oak, a powder room with a vessel basin and organic-shaped mirror, and a hallway with built-in wardrobes and integrated lighting. The primary bathroom featured a fluted-tile shower niche framed in marble.

Full project budget range (whole home): $120,000–$160,000. Kitchen portion estimated at $70,000–$90,000 based on comparable Reno Stars project data.

Comparable completed kitchen budgets from Reno Stars projects:

  • White shaker kitchen renovation, Vancouver: $70,000–$72,000
  • Marble-look kitchen + 2 bathrooms, Coal Harbour condo: $85,000–$90,000
  • Luxury curbless shower bathroom, North Vancouver: $42,000–$45,000
  • Luxury bathroom with champagne gold fixtures, West Vancouver: $36,000–$40,000

Marble-Look vs. Real Marble: What Richmond Homeowners Choose

Of kitchen renovation projects Reno Stars completed in 2025–2026, roughly 60% of homeowners who specified a premium stone aesthetic chose porcelain or quartz slab over real marble. The main reasons: real marble requires annual sealing and stains easily with acidic substances like lemon juice or wine. Porcelain slab (the material used in this Richmond project) is non-porous, does not require sealing, and is available in marble-look patterns that are virtually indistinguishable from the real thing at normal viewing distances. A 30-square-foot backsplash in premium porcelain costs $1,200–$3,600 installed, compared to $3,000–$7,500 for the same area in real honed marble.

Does a Richmond Kitchen Renovation Need a Permit?

Yes for any work that moves plumbing, alters electrical, or changes the layout. The City of Richmond charges $400–$800 for kitchen renovation permits. If you are removing or adding walls, opening up the ceiling, or relocating the sink or stove, a structural engineer may also be required — budget an additional $1,500–$3,000 for an engineers' assessment. Reno Stars handles the permit application as part of the project management scope.

How Long Does a Richmond Kitchen Renovation Take?

A full kitchen renovation in Richmond takes 6 to 10 weeks from demo to handover, based on Reno Stars project data. The timeline breaks down as follows: 1–2 weeks for demolition and rough-in, 2–4 weeks for cabinetry and countertop templating and installation, 1–2 weeks for tile and backsplash work, and 1–2 weeks for finishing, fixture installation, and final inspection. If the project includes a whole-home scope (as with the Richmond project), the full timeline extends to 12–16 weeks.

FAQ: Marble-Look Kitchen Renovation Costs in Richmond, BC

How much does a marble-look kitchen renovation cost in Richmond, BC?

A marble-look kitchen renovation in Richmond, BC costs between $70,000 and $120,000 in 2026 depending on scope and finish level. A whole-home renovation centred on a marble-look kitchen typically runs $120,000–$160,000 total. Prices are based on Reno Stars actual project data and comparable Metro Vancouver kitchen renovation costs.

Is porcelain slab better than real marble for a kitchen?

For most homeowners, yes. Porcelain slab does not stain, does not require annual sealing, and costs roughly 60–70% less than real marble. A marble-look porcelain slab costs $40–$120 per square foot installed versus $3,000–$7,500 for the same coverage area in real honed marble. The visual difference at normal viewing distance is negligible for most patterns.

Does Richmond require a permit for kitchen renovation?

Yes. The City of Richmond requires a building permit for any kitchen renovation that moves plumbing, alters electrical, or changes the layout. Permit fees range from $400 to $800. If structural walls are being removed or added, a structural engineer assessment is also required, adding $1,500–$3,000 to the project cost.

What is the timeline for a Richmond kitchen renovation?

A standalone kitchen renovation in Richmond takes 6 to 10 weeks from demo to handover. A whole-home renovation that includes a kitchen runs 12 to 16 weeks. Reno Stars project data from 2025–2026 across Metro Vancouver confirms these timelines are typical for occupied homes.

What is the ROI for a kitchen renovation in Metro Vancouver?

According to Reno Stars project data, kitchen renovations in Metro Vancouver recover 70–85% of their cost in resale value when the work is done to a mid-to-high quality standard. High-end finishes like marble-look porcelain, arched glass cabinets, and brushed gold hardware are particularly effective at recovering value in the $1M–$2M property bracket common in Richmond and West Vancouver.

列治文的大理石紋廚房裝修費用介乎 70,000 至 120,000 加元，視乎工程範圍及用料而定。包含大理石紋廚房的全屋翻新工程（如聚星裝修在列治文的實際項目）費用約為 120,000 至 160,000 加元。

列治文大理石紋廚房裝修費用較高的原因

大理石紋廚房的費用高於普通廚房，主要取決於三個選擇：用作牆面及檯面的材料、櫃門款式，以及五金配件的用料。全高度大理石紋瓷磚板費用為每平方尺 $40–$120（連工），而標準瓷磚為 $15–$40。拱形玻璃門上層櫃造價較標準梳化櫃每線尺多 $200–$500。啞黑色水龍頭及配件亦比普通鍍鉻款貴 $800–$1,800。

真實案例：列治文全屋裝修之大理石紋廚房

聚星裝修在列治文的項目中，廚房採用全高度大理石紋瓷磚覆蓋牆面及檯面，配以拱形玻璃門上層櫃、啞黑色水龍頭及嵌入式洗手盤。工程並包括樓梯重 建（淺色橡木）、化妝間（台上洗手盤及有機形狀鏡）、走廊嵌入式衣櫃（連照明），以及主人浴室的凹槽瓷磚淋浴間。

參考工程預算（全屋）：$120,000–$160,000。廚房部分估計 $70,000–$90,000（根據聚星裝修其他項目數據）。

  • 白色櫻桃核廚房，溫哥華：$70,000–$72,000
  • 大理石紋廚房 + 2 浴室，Coal Harbour 柏文：$85,000–$90,000
  • 豪華浴室，北溫：$42,000–$45,000

大理石紋與真石的比較

列治文選擇大理石紋 aesthetic 的業主中，約 60% 選用瓷磚板或石英石板而非真大理石。主要原因：真大理石需要每年密封處理，且容易受酸性物質染色。瓷磚板（本案選用材料）不透水、無需密封，視覺效果與真大理石在正常距離幾乎無法區分。

需要。凡涉及水管移動、電路改動或佈局變更的廚房工程，必須向列治文市政府申請建築許可證。許可證費用為 $400–$800。如需拆除或加建牆壁，亦需結構工程師評估，額外費用約 $1,500–$3,000。
